```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(stringr)
})

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
result_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1) args[[1]] else Sys.getenv("RESULT_DIR", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(result_dir)) stop("Provide RESULT_DIR or pass the result directory as a trailing argument.")
result_dir <- normalizePath(result_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
derived_dir <- file.path(result_dir, "derived")
fig_dir <- file.path(result_dir, "figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

method_tau_summary <- read_csv(file.path(derived_dir, "method_tau_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
method_overall_summary <- read_csv(file.path(derived_dir, "method_overall_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

method_order <- c(
  "Weibull Plug-in",
  "Cox Plug-in",
  "Log-Normal Plug-in",
  "CP + Weibull",
  "CP + Cox",
  "CP + Log-Normal"
)

method_colors <- c(
  "Weibull Plug-in" = "#4C78A8",
  "Cox Plug-in" = "#59A14F",
  "Log-Normal Plug-in" = "#E15759",
  "CP + Weibull" = "#4C78A8",
  "CP + Cox" = "#59A14F",
  "CP + Log-Normal" = "#E15759"
)

method_shapes <- c(
  "Weibull Plug-in" = 16,
  "Cox Plug-in" = 16,
  "Log-Normal Plug-in" = 16,
  "CP + Weibull" = 15,
  "CP + Cox" = 15,
  "CP + Log-Normal" = 15
)

save_plot <- function(filename, plot, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, filename), plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
}

method_tau_summary <- method_tau_summary %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = factor(method_label, levels = method_order),
    scenario_label = factor(
      scenario_label,
      levels = c("Log-Normal AFT (Linear)", "Log-Normal AFT (Nonlinear)")
    )
  )

method_overall_summary <- method_overall_summary %>%
  mutate(
    method_label = factor(method_label, levels = method_order),
    scenario_label = factor(
      scenario_label,
      levels = c("Log-Normal AFT (Linear)", "Log-Normal AFT (Nonlinear)")
    )
  )
```

# Overall Summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  method_overall_summary %>%
    transmute(
      Scenario = scenario_label,
      Method = method_label,
      `Avg Coverage` = sprintf("%.3f", coverage_mean_avg),
      `Avg Length` = sprintf("%.3f", length_mean_avg),
      `Avg |Cov-0.9|` = sprintf("%.3f", abs_cov_error_avg),
      Status = spec_status
    )
)
```

# Coverage Across Tau

```{r}
p_cov <- ggplot(
  method_tau_summary,
  aes(
    x = tau_quantile,
    y = coverage_mean,
    color = method_label,
    shape = method_label,
    group = method_label
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.90, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray45", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = coverage_ci_low, ymax = coverage_ci_high), width = 0.012, linewidth = 0.35) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario_label, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(method_tau_summary$tau_quantile))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.82, 0.98)) +
  labs(
    x = "tau quantile used in the DGP",
    y = "mean empirical coverage",
    color = "Method",
    shape = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_cov
save_plot("coverage_vs_tau_by_method.pdf", p_cov, width = 10.5, height = 7.8)
```

# Length Across Tau

```{r}
p_len <- ggplot(
  method_tau_summary,
  aes(
    x = tau_quantile,
    y = length_mean,
    color = method_label,
    shape = method_label,
    group = method_label
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.65) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = length_ci_low, ymax = length_ci_high), width = 0.012, linewidth = 0.35) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(method_tau_summary$tau_quantile))) +
  labs(
    x = "tau quantile used in the DGP",
    y = "mean interval length",
    color = "Method",
    shape = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_len
save_plot("length_vs_tau_by_method.pdf", p_len, width = 10.5, height = 7.8)
```

# Coverage-Length Tradeoff

```{r}
tradeoff_df <- method_tau_summary %>%
  mutate(panel = paste0(scenario_label, "\n", "tau_q=", formatC(tau_quantile, digits = 2, format = "f")))

p_trade <- ggplot(
  tradeoff_df,
  aes(
    x = length_mean,
    y = coverage_mean,
    color = method_label,
    shape = method_label
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.90, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray45", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "mean interval length",
    y = "mean empirical coverage",
    color = "Method",
    shape = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_trade
save_plot("coverage_length_tradeoff_by_tau.pdf", p_trade, width = 11.5, height = 8.2)
```
